positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Prepare materials for two courses – Intro to Object Oriented Programming, and Accelerated Intro to Computer Science • Assist students in lab assignments and course materials
• Grade students’ assignments

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Worked for University of Chicago's Department of Human Genetics on the Lynx Project. 
My task was to create a web-based tool that aids researchers in finding, analyzing and visualizing pairs of identical human protein sequences.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Production Manager
positions.description:
•	Delegated tasks to approximately 200 members; kept track of the musical’s schedule and supervised the its materials
•	Contacted sponsors; managed finance and public relations activities based on Facebook Insights and Youtube Analytics
•	Casting, script editing, and co-editing trailers and posters using Adobe Premiere and Adobe Illustrator
•	Produced musicals which attracted 3500 audience; the musical’s Facebook page reached 9000 followers.

positions.title: Co-founder & Main Designer & Cameraman
positions.description:
A project that supported the war victims in Quang Tri province by raising the society’s awareness of the war consequences through photography– documentary exhibition:

• Designed graphic & filming materials

• Designed the outlook of the exhibit

positions.title: President
positions.description:
•	Managed a team of 52 members; organized activities for music lovers in Hanoi
•	Designed branding materials: poster, logo, etc. using Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
•	Organized monthly shows with diverse performances, each of which attracted over 100 audiences
